explanation: It recalls the legend that the Mexica would build their city where they saw this sign. That city was Tenochtitlan, on whose ruins Mexico City stands.

claims.text: Mexico's flag shows an eagle perched on a cactus, eating a snake.

Mexico City stands on the ruins of Tenochtitlan.
